thesis: NerdWallet (Nasdaq: NRDS). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-05) and Item 2.02 earnings release EX-99.1 read. Revenue Q3 239.6M vs 215.1M (+11%); 9M 659.1M vs 611.2M (+8%); consumer +12% helped by student loans (+25.0M) and the College Finance acquisition, auto insurance -17.4M. Q3 income from operations 19.4M vs 34.4M (-44%) because sales and marketing rose 28% (173.2M vs 135.3M); 9M operating income 53.6M vs 45.8M. TTM (FY2025 10-K + 9M26 - 9M25, USD M): revenue 884.5 (836.6-611.2+659.1), net income 53.6 (48.7-34.7+39.6), OCF 147.0 (131.6-92.7+108.1), capex 15.8 (PP&E 1.0 plus capitalised software 14.8), FCF 131.2; SBC 31.2, FCF after SBC about 100.0. Shares 63,396,771 (31,711,119 Class A plus 31,685,652 Class B at 2026-10-30, 10-Q cover) after 9.8M shares repurchased for 99.7M in 9M26 (down from 71.3M at 2025-12-31). Close 7.14 (2026-11-20, two sources agree) x 63.40M = 453M: 8.4x TTM GAAP earnings, 0.51x TTM revenue, FCF yield 29.0% (22.1% after SBC), about 1.3x book equity 341.4M. Balance sheet 2026-09-30: cash 73.5M, total liabilities 98.3M, no funded corporate debt identified (a mortgage warehouse line exists; balance not read). Why the market may discount it: Q3 marketing spend grew far faster than revenue, margins fell, auto-insurance lead volume is falling, organic search traffic pressure is cited, and cash fell 39% y/y to 73.5M because of buybacks; the price implied is a business whose cash earnings fade. Evidence differing: TTM FCF 131M is 29% of market cap, 9M OCF +17% y/y, buybacks shrinking the count about 11% in nine months.
counterthesis: FCF is flattered by working-capital and non-cash items: 9M OCF 108.1M includes 11.7M deferred taxes and 11.1M payables increase, while receivables rose 11.3M; SBC 24.2M in 9M is real dilution cost; sales and marketing at 73% of Q3 revenue means earnings depend on paid traffic and partner budgets; Q3 operating margin 8% vs 16% a year ago; search-engine and AI-answer traffic risk (organic search pressure cited for SMB); revenue growth partly acquired; performance-marketing revenue is cyclical with credit and insurance cycles; the price (7.14) implies the market expects decline, cause of recent price weakness not found; the 5.00 range of tiny absolute market cap (453M) means liquidity and volatility risk.
invalidation: Drop if Q4 and 2027 revenue growth turns negative, operating margin stays below 8% as marketing intensity rises, OCF conversion falls below 100% of net income, or buybacks are funded by debt. Study further only if peer multiples confirm a discount, marketing returns (revenue per marketing dollar) are shown stable, and the quote and price history are independently verified.
